fields.verbatim: Design a compact desktop storage box with a reusable latch.
The box should open and close repeatedly without accidental opening during normal handling.
The latch should be easy for a user to operate while remaining secure during transport.
The product should be suitable for low-cost manufacturing and should be practical for desktop use.
The design should be mechanically plausible and easy to assemble.

fields.derivation_premises: A product that occupies excessive volume cannot be placed on a desktop as compact storage.
fields.statement: The product must occupy a compact spatial envelope suitable for placement on a desktop.

fields.derivation_premises: A latch that cannot be re-engaged is not reusable.
fields.statement: The product must provide a latching function that can be engaged and disengaged multiple times without replacement.

fields.derivation_premises: Opening and closing requires relative motion.
fields.statement: The product must permit relative motion between a closing role and a body role sufficient to open and close.

fields.derivation_premises: Accidental opening would occur if the latch cannot resist normal handling loads.
fields.statement: The latch must maintain closure under normal handling loads unless the user intentionally actuates it.

fields.derivation_premises: A latch that cannot be reached or requires excessive force is not easy to operate.
fields.statement: The user must be able to reach and actuate the latch with low effort and without special tools.

fields.derivation_premises: Transport loads could separate the latch if not retained.
fields.statement: The latch must remain closed under transport vibration and shock.

fields.derivation_premises: Manufacturing process choice determines cost.
fields.statement: The product must be suitable for low-cost manufacturing.

fields.derivation_premises: A product that topples or damages the desktop is not practical.
fields.statement: The product must be stable and safe on a desktop, not requiring excessive space or causing damage.

fields.derivation_premises: Conflicting constraints make a mechanism impossible.
fields.statement: The product must have a kinematically plausible arrangement with appropriate degrees of freedom.

fields.derivation_premises: If components cannot be inserted or joined, assembly is not easy.
fields.statement: The product must be assemblable by an operator without excessive difficulty.

fields.derivation_premises: A revolute pair constrains all but one rotational DOF.
fields.statement: For any revolute hinge, relative rotation between closing and body roles must be permitted about one axis while other relative motions are prevented; axial retention and radial support must be provided.

fields.derivation_premises: Flexure relies on elastic strain and fatigue life.
fields.statement: For any compliant flexure hinge, a flexible region must permit repeated elastic bending without yielding or fatigue failure and must maintain material continuity.

fields.derivation_premises: A prismatic pair requires contacting guide surfaces.
fields.statement: For any prismatic sliding pair, two parallel surfaces must guide linear motion with lateral support and end stops to limit travel.

fields.derivation_premises: Snap engagement relies on deflection and contact.
fields.statement: For any detent/snap latch, a deflectable member must engage a recess with sufficient retention force to resist opening loads and must allow user disengagement.

fields.derivation_premises: Over-centre requires a kinematic toggle.
fields.statement: For any over-centre latch, a linkage must pass through a toggle position that holds closure until the user moves it back.

fields.derivation_premises: Friction force resists slip.
fields.statement: For any friction hold latch, sufficient normal force and friction coefficient must exist between contacting surfaces to prevent slip under applied loads.

fields.derivation_premises: A separate part must be captured and moved.
fields.statement: For any separate retaining member, an additional part must be retained with the product and manually manipulated to engage or disengage closure.

fields.derivation_premises: Direct manual actuation requires physical access.
fields.statement: The latch actuation role must be accessible to the user's fingers and allow sufficient travel and force input for direct manual actuation.

fields.derivation_premises: Straight insertion requires a clear linear path.
fields.statement: For straight insertion assembly, components must be aligned along a single axis and inserted without interference.

fields.derivation_premises: Elastic insertion requires temporary deflection.
fields.statement: For elastic insertion assembly, a component must elastically deform during assembly and recover.
